message: 45M. I've had crushing pressure in the center of my chest for the last 30 minutes, it's going into my left arm and I feel sweaty and a bit sick to my stomach. I have high cholesterol.
title: 45M. I've had crushing pressure in the center of my chest for the last 30 minutes, it's going into…

fable.rationale: Classic acute coronary syndrome presentation: crushing central chest pressure >30 min radiating to left arm with diaphoresis and nausea in a 45M with hyperlipidemia. Requires emergency services (911) immediately.

medgemma.rationale: Symptoms suggestive of acute coronary syndrome (chest pain, radiation, diaphoresis, nausea).

v25.rationale: A 45-year-old man reports 30 minutes of crushing central chest pressure radiating to the left arm with sweating and nausea, a presentation that plausibly represents acute coronary syndrome and requires immediate emergency assessment.

earlyActions.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.
earlyActions.label: Issued early action; not a completed release
